name: skryensya-ui
description: Turborepo for skryensya/ui. Core contains tokens and the framework-agnostic component contract.

comment-overrides: The 8 entries below @types/node close the 20 advisories `pnpm audit` was reporting
(9 high, 10 moderate, 1 low). NONE is a direct dependency of this repo: all 8 come in from
underneath (astro, vite, jsdom, the MCP SDK), so there is no package.json to bump them in and an
override is the only place they can be reached from.
CARET AND NOT >=: ^ stays inside the major the tree already uses, which is exactly what makes
this safe to apply blindly over someone else's dependencies. Verified before writing it:
each of the 8 appears with ONE single major in the lockfile, so there is no consumer
expecting another line that forcing it would break.
devalue (added 2026-09-26, GHSA-9rgm-9g3h-6x36, DoS on malformed input): reached only through
@astrojs/react in apps/docs. 5.9.2 is the first patched version and the newest one past the
30-day cooldown on the day it was added; one major (5) in the lockfile, so the caret is safe.
Raised to ^5.9.4 on 2026-10-03: 5.9.3 closed three more HIGH advisories (shared-memory stringify,
quadratic expansion in uneval, an unhandled rejection in stringifyAsync) and 5.9.4 followed it
twenty minutes later. Both are inside the cooldown, see minimumReleaseAgeExclude.
proxy-addr, source-map-js and sharp (added 2026-10-07): a CRITICAL IP-spoofing advisory under
packages/mcp > express, a HIGH source-map DoS under apps/docs > astro, and a HIGH librsvg CVE in
sharp's bundled libvips. One major each in the lockfile; all inside the cooldown, see
minimumReleaseAgeExclude. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (same day, HIGH OAuth credential leak) is
overridden because evals > @tanstack/ai-mcp brings its own copy; `~` keeps it on the patched floor.
The entry is deleted when the package above bumps on its own: an override that no longer changes
anything is a frozen old version waiting for someone to notice it.
